We chose Dadeland Animal Hospital for the care of our new 1-year old rescue kitty from the list of Pet Assure providers. It is conveniently located off US1. Everyone in the clinic was very friendly and offered us great advice as new cat owners. Dr. Bonammy was gentle, caring and knowledgable and the 2 vet techs who worked with our kitty were professional and communicative. We left our appointment very confident that we made the right decision choosing Dadeland Animal Hospital!
Thank you Dr. Soto and staff for being so attentive with my Bonifacio. Amazing clinic and affordable.

Very nice helpful people. They take care of your animals.
Very happy to be part of the Dadeland Animal Hospital clientele!
Excellent service and very friendly staff
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. It means a great deal to our hospital!
We really appreciate your 5-star rating, thank you!

My dog broke her leg and needed surgery. I actually came from a different vet that I’ve always took my animals to and just wasn’t happy with the experience. So I decided to get a second opinion and Dadeland Animal Hospital just felt like the right choice. They were caring, affectionate towards my dog, informative, and everyone was extremely nice and professional. Will definitely continue to go back.
Thank you for the 5-star review! Your support means a lot to our team.

No empathy for your pet. Dr. Soto treated my Yorkie 5 weeks ago. The results were worse than what I initially took her for.  My dog will NOT STOP BLEEDING from her anus. Told the receptionist this and the doctor still refused to see her. Even though I begged her.  I called them early in the morning. Instead they referred my poor Yorkie to a pet ER.
Thank you for your feedback. If you'd like to discuss your experience further, please contact the hospital and ask to speak with management.
Dr. Soto is the best. He has been taking care of our dog for over two  years  and saved his life several times.
I LIKED VERY MUCH.THE PEOPLE WHO WORK THERE ARE VERY NICE.THANK YOU
Excellent service

I brought my sweet cat Charlie in for a routine exam and was told he needed an ear cleaning. After the procedure, Charlie lost his hearing and to this day still cannot hear. What made this situation even worse was the lack of concern or remorse shown by the vet afterward. There was no explanation, empathy, or effort to help us understand what happened. No one was held accountable for my healthy cat’s sudden hearing loss.
This outcome has been devastating for our family, and due to the severity of the harm and the clinic’s response, we are now considering our legal options regarding possible malpractice. I would not trust this clinic with my pet’s care. If you love your pet, do not bring them to this place.

My poor dog is having a terrible allergic reaction. My appt was scheduled to 5:30pm and when I arrived they told me that was not my appointment time and that my dog can’t be seen. Then they said they left voicemail trying to reschedule. There was no voicemail. Terrible commutation
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We're glad to know you had a great experience with our team.
The staff is always so friendly.
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We're delighted to know you had a great experience with us!
They have been taking care of my 130 lbs German shepherd for the past 6 years , always available, forward with the cost and great service
Great staff. Very patient and friendly. It's not easy to handle a big dog, especially mine since he is so vocal but they were patient and kind.  This neurotic dog mom totally recommends them.
Nice and professional!!
Great!
Very thorough, helpful, and friendly staff!
Friendly staff and timely efficient care for our new puppy. Didn’t feel rushed with Dr. Soto with our many questions

We brought in our beautiful Dachshund Mindy who had fallen ill, she was seen by  Dr. Davila who was great. A wonderful Doctor/person, he walked outside to personally give me the sad diagnosis. He also spoke over the phone with both my son and daughter in law, my son who is in the Military stationed outside of Florida was devastated, Dr. Davila along with Tommy the Tech (who was also awesome), were  accommodating, they were willing ready and able to get on the phone with my son and explain the issue, and also comfort him. They took the time to make sure we chose what was best for our baby Mindy, they thoroughly explained the options and outcome and allowed us  to choose by providing all details, we knew it wasn't good. My son wanted to say goodbye and be able to spend her last days with her but  could not get a military leave so the only option was facetime. That evening I was able to face-time with my son where he saw Mindy and spoke to her. With a heavy heart I have to say she passed the next afternoon. She was at home where she spent 14 years, she was in her bed, in her surroundings and even ate before she left us. She suffered heart failure and Dr. Avila  immediately diagnosed her, had it not been for Dr. Davila and Tommy this horrific sad time would have been so much worse. They made the difference by preparing us and being so attentive, accommodating,  kind and caring, I know Mindy felt genuine care when she was being seen by Dr. Davila. he also administered a shot to make her  breathing more comfortable by eliminating fluid.They were extremely sweet and loving with her.. After she passed I called them they were about to close, but they waited for me. As I drove away I felt peace knowing that I had left her in caring hands.  They arranged her private cremation, when she is ready, we will bring her home where she will for ever remain with us. They expressed how sorry they were for our loss and I know they genuinely meant it. Everything that could have been done was done I had her in excellent care R.I.P. in Furry heaven, our beautiful Mindy, play lots, eat bunches, you and Keanu are together again and he will make sure to follow you around and annoy you, and you will love every minute of it.
Love both vets here.  They truly take the time to sit and explain, and genuinely care about the animals.
Great service and care ! Super clean clinic . Nella was such great help, she and the Dr. Soto answered all my questions and took their time informing me about the issues with my pup .

We have been taking our Boxer to the Dadeland Animal Hospital since he was a puppy and he and we have always been treated with respect and kindness. All who work here are fantastic! Highly recommend this vet office.
Dr. Juan Soto and his entire team were great with our puppy. Thorough and friendly and answered all of our questions!
Great animal hospital good price and loving customer experience
Excellent
Dadeland Animal Hospital has been taking care of my pets for a long time and they have always been the best at treating and caring for my dogs!

I was worried my dog had a tick, so I brought her here for the first time. They took me in quickly and gave her a thorough inspection but it wasn’t a tick. They then completed a full exam to make sure she was healthy.  After getting approval she was good they answered any questions happily. I will definitely recommend them.

I'd like to express my deepest gratitude to the staff and doctors at The Dadeland Animal Hospital, specially to Doctor Juan Soto, his compassion and humanity goes beyond his line of duty. He performed two surgeries on Beau my dog and both times he was very informative, knowledgeable and CARING, very easy to talk to, I feel very blessed to have found this hospital. I also like to sincerely thank Nicky since she introduced me to Doctor Soto, also her brother Anthony, they both work with Dr. Soto. Prior to Dr Soto, the Sunset Animal Clinic was Beau's clinic but when he became sick and needed surgery the estimate Sunset gave was the double of what Dr. Soto charged so I moved him to Doctor Soto. Thank you, Dr. Soto, for being a great veterinarian!
The hospital is great! Very clean, the staff really know what they’re doing and they call when my dog needs his annual/shots!
Stella has been going to Dadeland Animal Vet since she was 2 months old. Great staff and service!
Love Dadeland veterinarians. Doctors and staff are awesome!!
Good service for our dog! they helped us solve a problem with a hernia that was result of surgery on another place (petsmart). Thanks for your service!
Such compassionate care of my Oliver!
Great place. Great people. Treated my benji to the utmost of respect and care. Will come back. Free first exam.
Very helpful staff. My dog was well taken care of. Will use their service again.
Good medical team, very friendly professionals.
I'm making the switch to Dadeland Animal Hospital. Dr. Bonnamy and his team are fabulous!
Omggggg I’m sooo happy I came today they are sooo good with our fur babies thank you to all staff and Dr 🥰 …
They are excellent took leo for two problems and they solved them.

I really can’t recommend this vet office enough. My poor 17 year old cat had been going to another vet regularly. He was having some really scary health issues and I was given a pretty grim diagnosis by that other vet office with no game plan. They just sent me in my way and said “good luck, take him to the neurologist and get a $6K MRI”.
Broken hearted I came to Dadeland Animal Hospital to get a second opinion. When I brought my cat in, Dr Soto was very intent on helping me figure out a plan, was down to earth and honest about what could be going on, and was very productive in helping me find solutions and navigate his health issues one step at a time. Him, the other vet (who was also wonderful), and their whole staff has been nothing short of supportive, analytical, and productive. While I may not know how much longer I have my furry best friend with me, I feel so much comfort knowing we are doing everything we can and the staff there equally cares about making his time left with me comfortable. I feel so much better bringing him there and that the staff will do whatever they can and he is in good hands. Thank you guys so much for being so passionate and caring! This is a hidden gem and everyone should be taking their pets here.
They took very good care of my lil Brownie and I'm so grateful
Fast and excellent service
They have been my dogs vets for 5 years. Love them. Highly recommend them.
Dr. Sosa and Lexi are amazing and treat our pup with so much love !

Was able to be seen as a new patient for an urgent issue the same day and I am so grateful! The staff was very attentive, patient, and thorough in their exam. I felt very confident in their guidance and expertise for next steps for my kitten to get him feeling better!

We appreciate your high rating of our services. Our goal is to provide the highest quality care, with love and compassion. Please don't hesitate to reach out if we can be of further assistance in any way.

I cannot express how amazed I am at the care that my cats received from Dr Soto! I’ve been to multiple places in Miami and no one could really help. Dr Soto gave me all the answers in much detail. He’s thorough, attentive, and knowledgeable. I am beyond grateful. Doctors like that are a rare find

To Dr. B and the Staff at Dadeland Animal Hospital,

I want to express my sincere gratitude for the care and compassion you showed during my recent visit with my dog Tia. Tia was unable to walk due to lameness in her back legs, and it was a difficult situation for us both.

Dr. B, your patience, gentle manner, and knowledge made a challenging moment much easier. I truly appreciate the time you took to evaluate her and explain the treatment plan. We left with medications and a renewed sense of hope, and I’m optimistic about her recovery.

Thank you again to the entire team for your kindness and professionalism.
Great staff and doctors!
